ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low; approximately 0.05:0.95 ratio of high-intensity pixels (localized to distal tips and water spray) to low-intensity pixels (solid charcoal/black primary surface).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant homogeneous low-intensity (black) across the entire central surface area; high-contrast, heterogeneous tan and white pixel clusters concentrated exclusively at the extreme lateral distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate vertex angle of 50-60 degrees, bisecting the two fluke lobes with high edge definition.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing boundary; peak-to-valley amplitude is most pronounced on the inner half of each lobe near the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve with a convex arc originating from the median notch, flattening into a straight or slightly concave path toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially dense clusters of high-contrast tan/white circular pixel structures located at both the left and right fluke corners, representing non-pigment surface accumulation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral encrustations at the distal tips; several isolated small-diameter high-intensity white points (pockmarks) on the central right lobe surface.
